title: Integer-indexed evaluation square for arbitrary injective resolutions
statement: Let f:Y→X be a scheme morphism [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], G and G′ abelian etale sheaves on X and Y [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], R and R′ injective resolutions [def-sp-injective-resolutions], v:f*G→G′ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], and ψ:f*(R.cochainComplex)→R′.cochainComplex a morphism of integer-indexed complexes commuting with their augmentations. Let b be the integer-indexed global sections unit followed by Γ(Y,ψ). For p≥0, H^p(b), followed by inverse evaluation classSectionsIso [def-weil-pbc-ext-resolution-sections-iso] and the inverse Ext/resolution isomorphism, equals inverse evaluation and inverse Ext/resolution for R followed by H^p(v) composed with cohomologyMap(f,G,p) [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. This concerns only integer-indexed sections homology; it makes no identification with nonnegative sections homology.

source.place: Tags 06XR, 01F8 (equations 01F9/01FA), 08J6, and the row comparison of Tags 015J/015K

proof.text: Represent each Ext class by a cohomology class and then a single cocycle. The chain-map equation makes α;f*(a);ψ a cocycle. Apply the exact-functor coefficient formula; left homology map data and the quotient projection descend the cocycle formula to Hom-complex homology.

Transpose the constant-sheaf pullback comparison using constantSheaf_pullback_transpose. The explicit naturality equation for ΓNatIsoSheafSections, postcomposed with the terminal-section and target Γ comparisons, identifies the global-sections adjunction unit with ceSectionsUnit. Evaluate at 1 and use adjunction naturality in the target sheaf to handle ψ. The fromSingleMk component formulas give the complexSectionsIso square.

Apply the homology functor to the evaluation square. Apply the proved generic ext_homComplex_naturality with the homotopy obtained from the supplied augmentation equality. This gives the forward square for the Ext/resolution equivalence followed by classSectionsIso. Use Iso.eq_inv_comp twice, the forward equality with reassociation, and the hom-inverse identities to obtain the stated inverse-oriented equation.

lean.statement:
theorem ceIntegerSectionsIso_naturality {X Y : Scheme.{uNatural}} (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})
    (G' : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})
    (R : InjectiveResolution G) (R' : InjectiveResolution G')
    (v : (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} f).obj G ⟶ G')
    (ψ : ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} f).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj R.cochainComplex ⟶ R'.cochainComplex)
    (hψ : ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} f).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map R.ι' ≫ ψ =
      (HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} f) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).hom.app G ≫
      (CochainComplex.singleFunctor _ 0).map v ≫ R'.ι')
    (p : ℕ) :
    HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (ceIntegerSectionsMap f ψ) (p : ℤ) ≫
        (SheafPullbackResolution.classSectionsIso Y R'.cochainComplex (p : ℤ)).inv ≫
        (R'.extAddEquivCohomologyClass
      (X := SheafPullbackResolution.ZSheaf Y) (n := p)).toAddCommGrpIso.inv =
      (SheafPullbackResolution.classSectionsIso X R.cochainComplex (p : ℤ)).inv ≫
        (R.extAddEquivCohomologyClass
      (X := SheafPullbackResolution.ZSheaf X) (n := p)).toAddCommGrpIso.inv ≫
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom ((Sheaf.H.map v p).comp (cohomologyMap f G p))
